title: G-EDM: add XYUV taper and 4-axis ruled wire post support

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Extend `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` to support `U`/`V` taper (`#536`) and 4-axis ruled cuts (`#537`, `#2690`) after `G-RBLv3` `U`/`V` semantics are confirmed.

## Context

Public `gedm.org` and `hackaday.io/project/190371-g-edm` documentation describes `XYUV` and `XYUVZ` G-EDM builds (including the reporter's `XYUVZ` machine), while the initial 2-axis `g-edm.cps` post refuses taper and 4-axis cuts by name. Before posting `U` and `V`, we must confirm on `#2697` whether `G-RBLv3` reads `U`/`V` as incremental upper-guide offsets from `X`/`Y` (matching CamCraft's `WireU`/`WireV` in `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs`) or as independent absolute coordinates, and whether any mode word is needed.

## What this does

- Confirm `G-RBLv3` `U`/`V` coordinate semantics, any required taper mode words, and `XYUV` machine dimensions from the reporter's answers on `#2697` or public G-EDM docs (read no `G-RBLv3` source code).
- Update `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` to emit `U`/`V` words on tapered (`#536`) and 4-axis (`#537`) straight moves when the mounted `wire_edm` machine declares `U`, `V`, `edm.max_taper_deg`, `edm.lower_guide_z`, and `edm.upper_guide_z`.
- Keep tapered arcs (`onCircular` with `WireU`/`WireV`) and 2-axis machines without `U`/`V` refused by name.
- Optionally add a confirmed `XYUV` G-EDM `.mch` file if travels, guide heights, and max taper have public or reporter-confirmed figures.
- Pin tapered and 4-axis `.nc` goldens and machine-limit refusals in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs` and `crates/post/tests/`.

## Done means:

- Tapered and 4-axis `WireContour` cuts post golden `.nc` programs on a `U`/`V`-capable G-EDM machine with confirmed `U`/`V` semantics documented in `docs/decisions/`.
- 2-axis machines and tapered arcs stay refused by name.
- `cargo xtask gate test g_edm --crate camcraft-app` and `cargo xtask gate test script_g_edm --crate camcraft-post` pass.

Part of #2697
